description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams used for filtering search results related to leave request comments. It extends a parent class DateRangeSearchFilterParams and specifies allowed sorting fields and a property for leave request ID with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for filtering leave request comment search results by date range and leave request ID, with a predefined sortable field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'leaveRequestComment.createdAt'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the leave request ID used as a filter; nullable integer.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter; accepts a nullable integer.
